name: Selection controls
purpose: Controls for choosing options: Checkbox (incl. indeterminate), Radio button, Chips (toggle / single-select / multi-select / delete) and Switch. Each available with a label. (The page also has selectable List/Card variants that compose these controls onto List items / Cards.)
$family: Covers the 'Selection controls' canvas: Checkbox, Radio buttons, Chips, Switch (+ List/Card 'select' compositions of existing components).

variants.name: checkbox
variants.use: Square box; checked/indeterminate fill with reverse check glyph. Supports error + disabled. CLEAN (form/*).

variants.name: radio
variants.use: Circular single-choice control. CLEAN (form/* + border-width small/medium).

variants.name: chip
variants.use: Pill toggle/selection/delete. Selected state = dark fill (deprecated active-surface set).

variants.name: switch
variants.use: On/off toggle. On-track dark, off-track white; disabled track greys (deprecated).

tokens.check-radio-glyph: icon/default-reverse (#fff on filled) / icon/default; disabled icon/disabled
tokens.label: text/default @ font-5 medium (checkbox/radio) / font-6 medium (chip); disabled text/disabled
tokens.chip/switch off+delete-surface (DEPRECAT: interactive (depricate)/on-light/surface/primary/default #fff / hover #f3f3f3 / pressed #767676 / disabled #fff → background/default + form/background/*

accessibility.semantics: Use native input semantics (checkbox/radio/switch) with a programmatic label; group radios/checkboxes in a fieldset/role=group with a legend
accessibility.switch: Switch should use role=switch with aria-checked; on/off must not be conveyed by colour/position alone — provide a label
accessibility.error: Error state pairs rag/error with a text message + aria-invalid, not colour alone (1.4.1)
accessibility.focus: Visible focus outline; controls and their labels are both click targets (44px)

antiPatterns: Conveying selected/on by colour alone without a label or check/thumb position
Checkbox/radio without an associated label or group legend
Leaving chip-selected / switch-on surfaces on the deprecated active-surface tokens — rebind to tertiary/background/active (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS (values resolve) — Checkbox + Radio CLEAN (form/*); Chips + Switch carry deprecated tokens. NEW recurring token: interactive (depricate)/on-light/surface/active/* = the selected/'on' dark fill.

tokens.usedBy: Chip toggle SELECTED fill + Switch ON track

depricateUsage.note: NEW recurring token group: interactive (depricate)/on-light/surface/active/* is the SELECTED/'on' dark fill (#000/#333/#767676) — best live target is tertiary/background/active (+ /pressed). Checkbox + Radio are fully migrated to form/*. Switch disabled track hits the no-equivalent subtle-surface blocker (neutral-2/3) seen across Avatar/Headers/List/Nav/Quick-actions.
